stories.headline: Maine community-forestry grants require tomorrow’s workshop
stories.body: Maine’s 2026 Project Canopy call requires prospective applicants to attend a virtual workshop October 29, from 1–3 p.m. The state lists December 17 at 11:59 p.m. as the application deadline and requires a 50% cash or in-kind match.

featuredResource.title: CARBINE — Forest Carbon Scenario Explorer Powered by FVS
featuredResource.description: CARBINE is a forest-carbon scenario app built around the USDA Forest Service’s Forest Vegetation Simulator. It helps readers explore stand conditions and management alternatives alongside carbon estimates when considering different forest-management scenarios.
